module_role: An Industrial Ethernet node that participates in PROFINET IO as an IO-Controller, IO-Device, or IO-Supervisor: it uses standard switched IEEE 802.3 Ethernet, is addressed by name via DCP, is described by a GSDML file, establishes/joins an Application Relation (AR) carrying IO-CR / Record-Data-CR / Alarm-CR, and exchanges cyclic provider/consumer process data (IOPS/IOCS + APDU status) plus acyclic CL-RPC records, in one of three performance classes (NRT/RT/IRT) per its conformance class (CC-A/CC-B/CC-C).
topology_description: Switched Ethernet line / star / tree / ring (MRP). Devices typically have an integrated 2-port switch for daisy-chaining into a line; a ring with a Media Redundancy Manager provides redundancy. IRT needs a fixed planned topology (LLDP + offline schedule).

integration_overview.addressing: name-based via DCP (IP optional via DCP/DHCP)
integration_overview.connection_model: AR (Application Relation) with IO-CR / Record-Data-CR / Alarm-CR
integration_overview.cyclic_model: provider/consumer with IOPS/IOCS + APDU Cycle Counter/Data Status
integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: record/index model (API, Slot, Subslot, Index) via CL-RPC plus DCP-managed station identity and Connect-negotiated AR/CR parameters.

interface_categories: Ethernet ports (2-port integrated switch typical) — standard IEEE 802.3 PHY/MAC.
PROFINET communication core — RT/IRT engine, DCP, AR/CR, alarm, diagnosis (ASIC/FPGA/firmware).
Application interface — slot/subslot I/O data to the device's application; engineering data via GSDML.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Ring with MRP (Media Redundancy Manager + Clients)
default_signal_values_when_omitted: MII / GMII: TX_EN, TX_ER, RX_DV, RX_ER, CRS, COL default to 0 (de-asserted); TXD / RXD default to 0x0. MDIO defaults to logic-1 (pulled up by the PHY's 1.5 kΩ resistor) when no STA driver is active. After BMCR Reset (0.15 = 1) the PHY restores BMCR + BMSR to spec-defined defaults (AutoNeg Enable = 1 if supported, Isolate = 1 if attached via 22.6 connector).
soc_dependent_items: Conformance class target (CC-A / CC-B / CC-C) and whether IRT hardware + PTCP are required.
Number of Ethernet ports and integrated-switch choice.
Send-clock factor / reduction ratio / watchdog factor for the IO-CR(s).
GSDML module/submodule layout and I/O data sizes.
MRP role (manager vs client) where redundancy is used.

low_power_modes.Active: Normal operation; MAC + PHY both running.
low_power_modes.Power_Down_BMCR_0_11: PHY in low-power state; MDIO remains responsive; PHY shall not generate spurious MII / GMII activity. Exit latency ≤ 0.5 s.
low_power_modes.Isolate_BMCR_0_10: PHY data paths to MII / GMII are high-Z; PHY remains MDIO-addressable.
low_power_modes.EEE_LPI_Clause_78: Energy Efficient Ethernet Low-Power Idle: PHY signals LPI on the link when MAC has no traffic; transmitter sleep + receiver alert + refresh cycles; not in 802.3-2005 — added in Clause 78.
